issue_results.text: Do the EU AI Act’s obligations for general-purpose AI model providers apply as of today, and have any of its high-risk system deadlines been formally postponed since the Act entered into force?

claims.text: As of today, no EU AI Act GPAI provider obligations apply, and no high-risk system deadline has been formally postponed since the Act entered into force.
claims.label: unsupported

claims.text: The Commission states that GPAI provider duties began applying on 2 August 2025 and that providers of models marketed after that date must comply.
claims.label: accepted

claims.text: The Commission states that providers of pre-existing GPAI models have until 2 August 2027 to comply.
claims.label: accepted

claims.text: The Commission reports an enacted AI Omnibus and extended high-risk application dates in 2027 and 2028.
claims.label: accepted

claims.text: The Act excludes sole-purpose scientific research models and pre-market research activities, but the latter exclusion does not cover real-world testing.
claims.label: accepted

claims.label: accepted

claims.text: As of today, no general-purpose AI model providers are subject to applicable GPAI provider obligations under the EU AI Act.

claims.label: accepted
